weaknesses.name: Double Free
weaknesses.reason: safe Rust: static analyzer proved no unsafe blocks and no FFI reachability; ownership and bounds checks prevent memory corruption

weaknesses.name: NULL Pointer Dereference
weaknesses.reason: safe Rust: static analyzer proved no unsafe blocks and no FFI reachability; ownership and bounds checks prevent memory corruption

weaknesses.name: OS Command Injection
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package declares no proc capability, analyzer verified zero process execution, and fscommand("exec") is permanently disabled as an audited no-op

weaknesses.name: SQL Injection
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package contains zero database clients or SQL sinks

weaknesses.name: Path Traversal
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package declares no fs capability; analyzer verified zero filesystem operations

weaknesses.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package declares no ui/network capability, renders no HTML/DOM structures, and strictly blocks javascript:/data:/vbscript:/file: URI schemes

weaknesses.name: Code Injection / Eval
weaknesses.reason: compiled Rust: no dynamic code evaluation, fscommand("exec") permanently disabled, and getURL/navigateToURL restricted to http:/https:/relative URIs

weaknesses.name: Improper Output Encoding
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package performs no serialized protocol formatting with unescaped control delimiters [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Log Injection
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package declares no stdout or OS logging capabilities, and diagnostic audit details strip ASCII control characters

weaknesses.name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
weaknesses.reason: computed exemption (unapproved): no step-bound proof is live, so the Warrant steps bounds are declarations that no tool checks.

weaknesses.name: Decompression Bomb
weaknesses.reason: delegates SWF container decompression exclusively to swf-container (SWF01) with bounded 256 MB cap and 50:1 ratio enforcement [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Uncontrolled Recursion
weaknesses.reason: bounded traversal: PaintScene digest recursion operates over bounded trees and display hierarchy depth is capped at 64 [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Inefficient Regular Expression (ReDoS)
weaknesses.reason: zero regular expressions: package contains no regular expression engines or pattern matching dependencies [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity
weaknesses.reason: bounded work per call: VM step budgets capped at MAX_HOST_VM_STEPS = 2_000_000, frame steps per tick capped at 1024, hierarchy depth capped at 64, character dictionary capped at 4096, and URI length capped at 2048 [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
weaknesses.reason: not applicable: no secret operands; non-cryptographic SWF player host shell, display/audio/VM integration, URI sanitization, and public SHA-256 scene digests. Recorded as an unapproved exemption because the registry defines no safe subset for CWE-208.

weaknesses.name: Use of Insufficiently Random Values
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package performs purely deterministic SWF playback and declares no rand capability

weaknesses.name: Use of Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
weaknesses.reason: no broken or risky cryptography: package uses FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 (coding_adventures_sha256) solely for deterministic headless PaintScene digest verification, with zero legacy ciphers or secret-key algorithms [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Inadequate Encryption Strength
weaknesses.reason: no keys: the package takes and generates no key material; operands are bounded SWF movies, display scenes, audio PCM buffers, input events, and public SHA-256 scene digests [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Concurrent Execution Race Condition
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package declares no thread capability and uses zero multithreading or shared mutable state

weaknesses.name: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package interacts with no external filesystem or process state

weaknesses.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package contains no dynamic object deserialization, polymorphic factories, or reflection [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Prototype Pollution
weaknesses.reason: strongly typed language: Rust has no object prototypes or dynamic prototype inheritance chains, and AVM frame scripts execute under avm-bytecode-lifter's isolated prototype cage [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]
